requires: orchestrator-recorded task names and attempt ordinals
ORCHESTRATOR_ATTESTED.limitation: The current worker surface does not export tamper-evident actual-read or complete-attempt traces into the run bundle.

OPERATOR_ATTESTED.limitation: Final-bundle statements alone cannot prove chronology, route isolation, fresh context, or absence of hidden attempts.

verdict_policy.PASS_INCREMENTAL_BEHAVIOR: All content and score thresholds pass with RUNTIME_OBSERVED provenance.
verdict_policy.PASS_DIAGNOSTIC_BEHAVIOR: All content and score thresholds pass, but provenance is ORCHESTRATOR_ATTESTED or OPERATOR_ATTESTED. This verdict never authorizes registration.
verdict_policy.FAIL_NO_REGISTRATION: A content, score, fidelity, acceptance, fairness, or provenance-integrity condition fails.

deterministically_provable: score arithmetic, medians, and revealed pair identity
proof_boundary: A diagnostic pass is detached synthetic-fixture evidence only. It is not registration authority, market evidence, or A-tier embodiment proof.
